Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the main change: the edited_app_store_app activity now reports the version's stored labels and configuration instead of values from the request. It is a fix, short, and specific enough for a teammate scanning history.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description states the root cause, the fix, and the test, and it links issue `#58486`. It includes the required 'Resolves' issue reference in the form 'Fixes `#58486`', a changes/ entry, and the AI disclosure. Most template checklist items are not marked, and the template's AI section (Tool and Model ID) is absent. The description does not mention the frontend, migration, or MDM command checklist items, which may not apply. The author should mark the applicable checklist items and add the AI section in the required format.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#58486` requires that the edited App Store app activity show the version's labels and configuration after an API edit, whatever fields the request sends. The diff to ee/server/service/vpp.go (merge base to head) builds the activity labels from updatedAppMeta.LabelsIncludeAny, LabelsExcludeAny, and LabelsIncludeAll using activitySoftwareLabelsFromSoftwareScopeLabels. It no longer uses validatedLabels from the request. The activity Configuration now uses updatedAppMeta.Configuration instead of payload.Configuration. The iOS/iPadOS plist is still wrapped as a JSON string, which keeps the existing form. The PR summary reports test TestUpdateAppStoreAppActivityKeepsStoredSettings for a name/self-service-only edit. I did not open the test file, so I rely on the summary for the test. The code change addresses the reported root cause.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** All changes connect to `#58486`. The vpp.go change sources the activity labels and configuration from the re-read stored app. The JSON-string wrapping block moved earlier in the method, so the activity and response both use the wrapped value. This move is required by the fix and does not change other behavior. The changes/ entry documents the fix. The vpp_test.go addition covers the reported partial-edit case. No unrelated changes appear in the reviewed diff. Limitation: I did not inspect the test file or the changes/ file contents directly.
